# Louiss Web Studio

> Web design and development studio based in Tangier, Morocco, building fast, conversion-focused websites for local and regional businesses. Pages are published in French (the indexed language) with English and Arabic available on the same URL via a runtime language switcher.

## Services
Design-first web development: Figma to production, or a full build from scratch.
- For direct clients: custom design in Figma, built end to end; Next.js, Tailwind or vanilla HTML/CSS/JS depending on project needs; headless CMS setup a non-developer team can manage; deployment, DNS and domain configuration handled.
- For agencies: pixel-accurate implementation from Figma files, fast turnaround for client deadlines, clean handoff with documented code, white-label delivery available.
- For international clients: multilingual builds in French, English and Arabic (RTL included); custom UI/UX and full-stack development, never a template; remote collaboration with clear deliverables.

## Case studies
- [Adventure Keys](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/adventure-keys) — website redesign for a travel and surf agency, built to turn visitors into bookings

- [El Majdoub Immobilier](https://www.louisswebstudio.com/el-majdoub) — real estate rental platform connecting owners and qualified tenants in Agadir
